title: Polar Code Based Federated Learning: Convergence Analysis and Resource Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed devices without sharing raw data; however, it faces significant communication bottlenecks and channel impairments in practice. Conventional network layer treatments either idealize the channel as error free or apply equal error protection (EEP) to transmitted model updates, failing to account for the inherently unequal importance of quantization bits within a single local model. To address this limitation, we propose a cross layer polar code based FL scheme that leverages the unequal error protection (UEP) property of polar codes under finite block lengths. Specifically, the proposed design selectively protects more significant quantization bits, thereby mitigating the detrimental effects of channel noise. translated_title: 基于极化码的联邦学习：收敛性分析与资源分配
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）使分布式设备能够在不共享原始数据的情况下协作训练模型；然而，在实际中它面临显著的通信瓶颈和信道损伤。传统的网络层处理方法要么将信道理想化为无差错，要么对传输的模型更新应用等错误保护（EEP），未能考虑到单个本地模型中量化比特固有的重要性差异。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于极化码的跨层联邦学习方案，利用极化码在有限块长度下的不等错误保护（UEP）特性。具体而言，该设计选择性地保护更重要的量化比特，从而减轻信道噪声的有害影响。我们进一步对所提方案进行了严格的收敛性分析，推导出收敛差距的上界，并随后对其进行联合优化。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于极化码的跨层联邦学习方案，利用不等错误保护特性优先保护重要量化比特，并给出了收敛性分析上界及资源分配优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a polar code based cross-layer federated learning scheme that leverages unequal error protection to prioritize important quantization bits, with convergence analysis and resource allocation optimization.
